frozen_factual_contract.role_dispute: The parties dispute only whether Serrano managed or supervised at least one other criminally responsible person; no premise depends on managing assets, property, or activities alone.
frozen_factual_contract.waiver_clause: Serrano knowingly and expressly waives the right to appeal the conviction and whatever sentence is imposed on any ground, including any appeal under 18 U.S.C. § 3742, except that the waiver does not bar a claim that the sentencing court completely denied him the personal opportunity to allocute required by Rule 32(i)(4)(A)(ii).
frozen_factual_contract.rule11_confirmation: The court addresses Serrano personally, separately explains the broad sentencing waiver and the complete-denial-of-allocution carve-out, and obtains his express confirmation that he understands both.
frozen_factual_contract.actual_allocution: The court never invites Serrano personally to speak before imposing sentence; counsel's remarks are not allocution, no contemporaneous objection is made, and the preserved mitigation creates a real possibility of a lower sentence.
frozen_factual_contract.actual_enhancement_disposition: Dismissed under the waiver without any merits view; full resentencing after allocution may recalculate the Guidelines.
frozen_factual_contract.counterfactual_predicate: The isolated notice is filed with the district clerk on day 15, not earlier under Rule 4(c); no Rule 4(b)(3) motion, government notice, clerk inaccessibility, or other time-shifting event exists. After prompt appellate docketing and limited remand, Serrano files a statement disclaiming an extension and every excuse. The district court then finds neither excusable neglect nor good cause and declines a Rule 4(b)(4) extension before promptly returning the record.
frozen_factual_contract.counterfactual_government_invocation: The government's March 25 first substantive filing addressing disposition invokes both Rule 4(b) untimeliness and the appeal waiver, preserving every apparent threshold ground under then-issued Kemp and Local Rule 27(f)(2). At the August 19 source cutoff, Melvin confirms that preservation rule; the earlier synthetic filing does not cite Melvin.
frozen_factual_contract.counterfactual_disposition: Dismiss the appeal under Rule 4(b) without reaching the alternative waiver ground or any merits question.
frozen_factual_contract.counterfactual_terminal_timing: The April 10 dismissal opinion and judgment leaves the ordinary 14-day criminal rehearing period to expire April 24 under Rule 40(d)(1), followed by Rule 41(b)'s ordinary seven-day interval and mandate issuance May 1. Both intervals remain ordinary.
frozen_factual_contract.source_authority_date_boundary: Every fictional source document cites only law issued by its own filing date. No source dated before June 18 cites Hunter, including the public/sealed A06/A07, A11/A12, and A13/A14 twins and A08/A10; no source dated before July 27 cites Melvin. Actual A18 may apply Hunter but need not cite Melvin. The fully pre-Hunter counterfactual branch may use Boutcher, Ashford, Marsh, Brantley, Kemp, and then-current rules, but no counterfactual source cites Hunter or Melvin; those later authorities may appear only in the August 19 core-law analysis.

media_boundary.reason: The successor corpus is PDF-only. Sealed-record grants, revocation, CAS resolution, and leased snapshots are synthetic workbench projections and do not represent access to PACER, CM/ECF, Probation, or any real presentence report.

sealed_record_twins.mapping_rule: Each page in every equal-page pair receives one record-unique stable logical anchor mapped to one public-surrogate or public-redacted physical anchor and one sealed physical anchor. Case, issue, disposition, and question resources reference only the stable logical anchor for paired material.
sealed_record_twins.remaining_stable_anchor_id_template: For each disclosure page offset not listed above, use ca4m4.serrano.anchor.stable.<disclosure-suffix>.page-<two-digit-one-based-offset>; listed semantic IDs replace the template ID at their exact offset.
sealed_record_twins.verification_rule: A workbench session grant is per disclosure and exact resolved pack closure. Revocation removes the sealed row and restores the public projection. Every authorized open independently verifies CAS path, size, digest, PDF readability, and page count before exposing a leased snapshot. These controls are synthetic and make no claim about real PACER, CM/ECF, Probation, or counsel access.
